verdict.rationale: Slack markets AI features (Slackbot briefing, channel/thread summarization, search across integrated data, meeting notes) and has live MCP/API infrastructure enabling agentic access, supporting AI-generated insights inside the product. However, evidence is mostly vendor marketing copy with no hands-on/community validation of insight quality, and community threads focus on unrelated pain points (pricing, export, moderation) rather than confirming AI insight delivery.
